name: Telangana Post-Matric Scholarship (BC/EBC)
benefit_summary: Post-matric scholarship for eligible BC and EBC students studying from Class 11 to PG.
deadline_note: Not yet announced. Check the official portal.

rules.label: Course level is post-matric (Class 11 to PG)

documents.name: Passport photo
documents.tip: A recent colour photo that meets the portal's size rules.

documents.name: Student Aadhaar card
documents.tip: Uploaded on the official portal only. This app never asks for the Aadhaar number.

documents.name: Bank passbook first page
documents.tip: The front page showing your account number and IFSC code.

documents.name: SSC hall ticket details
documents.tip: Have your SSC hall ticket number and year ready.

documents.name: Caste certificate (MeeSeva)
documents.tip: Issued through MeeSeva. Keep the original for checking.

documents.name: Income certificate (MeeSeva, dated after 1 April 2026)
documents.tip: Must be dated after 1 April 2026.

documents.name: College bonafide
documents.tip: A certificate from your college for the current year.

documents.name: Previous marks memos
documents.tip: Marks memos for your previous class or year.

steps.description: Open the TS ePASS portal and register with your mobile number.
Fill the application form with your details exactly as they appear on your certificates.
Upload the documents on the checklist, including your Aadhaar card on the portal.
Check everything, then submit the application and note the application number.
Track the status on the portal and answer any query from your college or department.

name: Telangana Post-Matric Scholarship (SC)
benefit_summary: Post-matric scholarship for eligible SC students studying from Class 11 to PG.
deadline_note: Not yet announced. Check the official portal.

rules.label: Annual income limit (conflicting sources)
source_evidence: Not verified. Reported SC limits differ (₹2,00,000 vs ₹2,50,000). G.O.Ms.No.9 (June 2026) revises 2026-27 limits; its text has not yet been reviewed.
